display_name: Growth rates of real output, US major industries (goods and trade), 1988-2010

triage.reason: Faithful formula replication of book figure 15.2A (goods-producing and trade industries panel). Log-difference growth rates of BEA real value added by industry. Data covers 1988-2010 (first valid growth year is 1988 given a 1987 level base; book caption reads 1987-2010 - documented, not an error). Units rate_decimal_log_diff consistent across all subseries.
